newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed wins logistics support contract.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed wins logistics support contract.

text.p: Lockheed Martin ASIC, a unit of Lockheed Martin Corp, said Wednesday it has been awarded its first logistics support contract by the United Kingdom Ministry of Defence for the comprehensive provision of spares and spares repair service for the Royal Navy's Merlin helicopters.

The Merlin Support and Spares Availability Systems program, valued at more than $450 million, calls for Lockheed Martin to provide the full spectrum of spares support for this new fleet of operational aircraft, the first of which is scheduled to enter service with the Royal Navy for fleet operations in early 1998, the company said.
The contract is for five years beginning in late 1997, Lockheed said.
